No. G721] PORT MORESBY, WEDNESDAY, 28th OCTOBER [2020

National Information and Communication Technology Act 2009

APPOINTMENT OF CHAIRMAN, CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER AND NON-EXECUTIVE
MEMBERS OF THE NATIONAL INFORMATION AND TECHNOLOGY AUTHORITY BOARD

I, GRAND CHIEF SIR BOB DADAE, GCL., G.C.M.G., K. St. J., Governor-General, by virtue of the powers
conferred by Sections 13, 16, 20 and 92(1)(e) of the National Information and Communication Technology Act 2009
and all other powers me enabling, acting with, and in accordance with, the advice of the National Information and
Communication Technology Authority Appointments Committee, hereby appoint —

(a) Noel Mobiha as Chairman to be non-executive member of the Board for a term of four (4) years; and

(6) Caroline Greenway as an independent expert to be non-executive member of the Board for a term of three
(3) years; and

(c) Kila Gulo-Vui as Chief Executive Officer, (ex-officio) to be executive member of the Board for a term of
five (5) years; and

(d) Kone Kula as the Private Sector Member of the Universal Access and Service Board for a period of four
(4) years,

with effect on and from the date of publication of this instrument in the National Gazette.

Dated this Tuesday, 27th day of October, 2020.
Sir BOB DADAE,

Governor-General.

Printed and Published by C. Lenturut, Government Printer,
Port Moresby.—721.
